m.d: A drink is a liquid that you take in through your mouth.
m.e: He served her a hot drink and some cake.

m.d: If you drink something, usually a liquid, you take it in through your mouth.
m.e: I drink coffee in the morning.

m.d: A drive is a trip by car.
m.e: Let's go for a drive down to the lake.

m.d: Drive is the feeling that you want or need to do something.
m.e: She has a strong drive to succeed.

m.d: A (disk) drive is part of a computer that reads and writes information to a disk.
If you drive a car or other vehicle, you control its movement and direction.
m.e: I've been learning how to drive a bus.

m.d: If you drive somewhere, you go there by car.
m.e: The bus is too slow. Let's drive to school instead.

m.d: If you drive someone or something, you make them move.
m.e: The dogs drove the cows into the field.

m.d: Dreams are the images and things you see when you are sleeping.
m.e: In my dream I had forgotten the baby in a drawer.

m.d: A dream is something you wish for or hope will happen.
m.e: The company is succeeding beyond anyone's wildest dreams.

m.d: If you dream about something, you wish for it.
m.e: She dreamed of becoming a concert pianist.

m.d: A drop is a very small amount of a liquid.
m.e: A drop of water weighs 0.1 grams.

m.d: A drop is the fall of something.
m.e: There was a drop in the prices last week.

m.d: To fall, or to let something fall.
m.e: He dropped from the roof when he was running.

m.d: A dress is a loose cloth covering a woman's body. The lower part is like a skirt. The top part is like a shirt.
m.e: She looked beautiful because she had a very nice dress.

m.d: To put clothes on something.
m.e: I dressed my little sister for school this morning.

m.d: To put clothes on yourself.
m.e: I just need to dress and then we can go.

m.d: To prepare the surface of a material (usually stone or lumber).
A drunk is a person who often drinks too much alcohol.
m.e: Two drunks were fighting in the street last night.

m.d: If someone is drunk, they have taken in too much alcohol.
m.e: After he left the restaurant, he was so drunk he couldn't walk.

m.d: If something is driving, it is moving quickly and strongly.
m.e: The driving wind blew the rain sideways.

m.d: A driver is a person who drives.
m.e: That man is a driver of cars.

m.d: A driver is a kind of golf club.
m.e: The golfer used his driver to hit the ball.

m.d: A driver is a computer program for an application and hardware, made for the device it controls.
m.e: The driver is used for the printer.

m.d: Drugs are substances such as alcohol, cocaine, or aspirin, that people take to make changes in their body.
m.e: He's in jail for 3 to 15 years for drug trafficking.

m.d: If you drug somebody, you give them a drug, usually to put them to sleep.
m.e: They put me in hospital, drugged me up and left me in there for two years.

m.d: To make something less wet.
m.e: The clothes dried in the sun.

m.d: If something is dry, it has no water or liquid on it.
m.e: The Sahara desert is dry.

m.d: When a game is tied and no one has won, then the game is a draw.
m.e: The game ended 3 to 3. We were disappointed that it was a draw.

m.d: A draw is when the winners of a lottery are announced.
m.e: The draw is on Tuesday. I hope I won.

m.d: When you draw, you use a pencil, pen, crayon, etc. to make a picture.
m.e: She drew a beautiful picture of the sky on a bright white piece of paper.

m.d: If a person is attracted or interested in an event, then he is drawn to it.
m.e: The discover of gold in the West drew many people living in the East to move westward.

m.d: If something is dramatic, it is large and sudden.
m.e: The increase in foreign students has meant a dramatic change in the number of schools.

m.d: If something is dramatic, it is connected with acting and theatre.
m.e: In a highly dramatic speech, he brought everyone to his side.

m.d: A mythical animal, usually reptile-like, with leathery wings like a bat, claws like a lion, scaly skin and a long tail, and breathes fire.
m.e: The prince had to kill a dragon before he could rescue the princess.

m.d: A large snake-like creature with the eyes of a rabbit, the horns of an ox, and the claws of a tiger.
A large reptile, especially a Komodo dragon.
If something is a drag, it's not fun and you don't want to do it.
m.e: Christmas was a real drag this year, since I was living alone.

m.d: If someone is a drag, they don't enjoy fun activities or they stop you from having fun.
m.e: He's such a drag to be with, studying all the time.

m.d: If you take a drag from a cigarette, you close your mouth and inhale through it.
m.e: I took the final drag from my final cigarette, and put it out, for good.

m.d: If you drag something, you pull it, usually with difficulty.
m.e: She heard the noise of a chair being dragged to the window.

m.d: If you drag your feet, you move or do something slowly.
m.e: Six months later, when nothing had happened, they complained that the city was still dragging its feet.

m.d: If you drag somebody somewhere, you take them there but they don't want to go.
m.e: Dad sent me to drag you back home.

m.d: Drew is a male given name.
A drama is a serious story for TV, stage, radio, etc.
m.e: The courtroom drama stars Melissa Gilbert as a young lawyer.

m.d: Drama is the art of theatre and the study of that art.
m.e: Canadians watch PBS for the best in British TV, both drama and comedy.

m.d: Drama is excitement, and exciting events, both good and bad.
m.e: Americans gathered around televisions to watch the drama unfolding on Capitol Hill.

m.d: A drawing is a picture.
m.e: He sketched a drawing of that vase.

m.d: A drawing is a contest where the person who wins is chosen randomly.
Droppings are the excrement of animals.
m.e: A rabbit's droppings.

m.d: A drill is an object used to dig a hole.
m.e: He used the drill to make a hole on the wall.

m.d: A practice before a major event is called a drill.
m.e: Our school often conduct fire drills to train us in case of a real fire.

m.d: A drill is a type of primate.
If you drill a hole, you use a drill to make a hole in something.
m.e: We must drill six holes in the wood for the screws.

m.d: If you drill some information into someone's head, you make them review it again and again until they remember it.
m.e: My teacher tried all ways to drill the mathematical concept into my head.

m.d: Something put on a wound to protect it.
Dressing is a sauce that is put on salads or other foods.
A bread-based food that is put on or around a turkey.
A drawer is a box made of wood that is part of a piece of furniture (such as a desk); drawers can slide in and out so that people can put things into them.
m.e: I keep my socks in the top drawer of the chest.

m.d: A drawer is a person who draws.
m.e: Did you draw this picture? Wow, you're a really good drawer.

m.d: A person who writes a bank draft, check, or promissory note.
m.e: We'll have to have a drawer draw up the promissory note.

m.d: To drown is an action where someone is struggling in water.
m.e: I remembered when I was young, I nearly drowned in the lake near my house.

m.d: The effect of drowning can also be produced intentionally.
If you drown something, you lose, make hard to find or unnoticeable in a great mass.
m.e: The CIA collects so much information that the actual answers it should seek are often drowned in the flood of reports.

m.d: A drum is a musical instrument with a skin that you hit to make music.
m.e: My cousin plays drums.

m.d: A drum is kind of big barrel.
m.e: They were keeping garbage in an old oil drum.

m.d: If you are drumming you are making music with a drum or drums.
m.e: I saw him drumming with the band.

m.d: If you are drumming, you are hitting or tapping something like it was a drum.
m.e: Sometimes I drum on my desk with my fingers.

m.d: A drain is a hole, sometimes in the bottom of a basin, to let water flow out, and a pipe attached to the hole.
m.e: After you wash, you should drain the water from the bath.

m.d: Someone drains something when they take the water or other liquid out of it.
m.e: She drained her cup in one gulp.

m.d: Something dreadful is something very bad.
m.e: There has been a dreadful accident.

m.d: A draft is a piece of writing which has been or may be edited.
m.e: In the first draft of the story the characters names are all different.

m.d: A draft is when the military or a sport team chooses its members.
m.e: Many Americans moved to Canada to avoid the draft during the war.

m.d: Depth of water needed to float a ship; depth below the water line to the bottom of a vessel's hull. (UK spelling: draught)
m.e: The ship had a draft of 6 feet.

m.d: If you draft a letter, memo, agreement, etc., you write one that has been or may be edited.
m.e: You should have the contract drafted by a lawyer.

m.d: If a state drafts someone, it chooses them to be in the military.
m.e: I was drafted when I was 20 and spent two years fighting in France.

m.d: If a team drafts someone, it chooses them to play on the team.
Drowning is the death of a person because he was under water or some other liquid too much time.
Drunken is another word for drunk.
m.e: I feel bad about my drunken behaviour last night.

m.d: An action when an object moves towards the earth slowly.
m.e: The plane ran out of fuel, therefore it had to drift slowly down to the nearby airport.

m.d: A driveway is a very short road leading to a house or garage. It is where cars are often parked at home.
If something is dripping, it is falling one drop at a time.
A drip is a small amount of water.
m.e: The tap is spoiled. Water just keeps coming down drip by drip.

m.d: A drip is an uninteresting person.
If something is dripping, it is falling one drop at a time.
m.e: My pen has been dripping throughout the day.

m.d: A drummer is a person who plays the drums.
Drawers are men's underpants, short pants that men wear under their clothes.
m.e: When he heard the doorbell ring, he didn't know whether to open the door because he was in his drawers.

m.d: A dryer is a machine for drying clothes.
If someone or something is drained, they are very tired; they do not have the motivation needed to continue.
Dread is the feeling of fear of meeting, facing, or dealing with something.
m.e: The idea of giving a speech in front of everyone filled her with dread.

m.d: A dread is a long matted string of hair.
If you dread something, you have a strong fear of meeting, facing, or dealing with it.
m.e: He dreaded the moment that she would leave him.

m.d: A drought is when there is less water in an area than normal.
m.e: The drought in California began in 2012.

m.d: Something is drastic, if it is serious, severe and violent.
A drugstore is a place where you can get prescription medicine.
If something is done dramatically, it is done in a dramatic way.
A drunkard is a person who is frequently drunk.
A drinker is a person who drinks alcohol regularly, and sometimes drinks too much of it.
A coffee drinker drinks coffee regularly; a tea drinker drinks tea regularly.
Drumming is the sound of drums.
m.e: We could hear the drumming from far away.

m.d: Drumming is the act of hitting a drum to make music.
If something is draining, it takes away your energy and makes you feel stressed and tired.
m.e: It's been very long, very tiresome, and very draining, but at last it's over.

m.d: Droll is the saliva that trickles from the mouth.
If a person drools, they secrete saliva out of their mouth.
When you are dreary, you are feeling very sad.
m.e: Jim felt rather dreary after he received his terrible examination results.

m.d: When something is dreary, it is dark and colourless.
m.e: The weather is very dreary today.

m.d: If something is dreamy, it resembles a dream.
A dreamy person is sexy or attractive.
If a place is dreamy, it has a pleasant or romantic atmosphere.
A dredge is an instrument that is used to gather objects from a water body.
A dredge is a large shaker for sprinkling spices or seasonings during food preparation.
If you dredge a river, canal, harbour, etc., you remove sand and mud from the bottom.
If you dredge up an unpleasant topic, you bring it up after a long time.
m.e: "Do you remember that time you crashed the car?" "You're not going to dredge that up again, are you?"

m.d: If you dredge up some information that has been hidden, you find it through hard work.
A drifter is someone who travels from place to place without staying anywhere for very long.
To use a drainage is engage in the action or process of draining something.
m.e: The pot has holes in the base for good drainage

m.d: A large insect with four wings and a long body. Dragonflies hunt other insects, such as mosquitoes.
If you dribble, you let saliva drip from your mouth; you drool.
If something dribbles, it falls in drop or an uneven flow; it trickles.
If you dribble a football/soccer ball, you run with it while controlling it with your feet.
A draught is a wind which blows through a building.
A draught is a piece which is used in a game called draughts.
A draught is a mild vesicatory.
To draught means to draw.
To draught means to pull something along, especially a vehicle or a tractor.
A drape is a long curtain.
Drape is the way which a piece of fabric hangs.
If you drape a scarf, you arrange the scarf loosely on or around your neck.
Another name for checkers.
If you wear your hair in dreads, you grow it into long matted strings.
m.e: She had the longest dreads I'd ever seen.

m.d: A drench is a medical or poisonous drink given to an animal.
If you are drenched, you are very wet all over.
m.e: She was drenched by the rain.

m.d: If you drench an animal, you dose it with medicine by force.
m.e: The vet had to drench the horse as it did not want to take its prescription.
